title: Smt. Prerna Paul vs Jugunu George Das on 19 February, 2021

paragraphs.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
 
 

?Court No. - 5
 

 
Case :- TRANSFER APPLICATION (CIVIL) No. - 270 of 2020
 

 
Applicant :- Smt. Prerna Paul
 
Opposite Party :- Jugunu George Das
 
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Prakash Dwivedi
 

 
Hon'ble Saral Srivastava,J.
This Court by order dated 09.02.2021 held the service of notice upon opposite party sufficient.
Accordingly, the transfer application is being heard exparte.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant.

The present application has been filed by the applicant-wife seeking transfer of Case No.555 of 2020 (Jugunu George Das Vs. Smt. Prerna Paul), under Section 10 (ix) & (x) of the Divorce Act 1869 pending in the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, District Meerut to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Agra.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is working in Bank and at present she is posted at Agra. He further submits that the applicant has a minor child which she has to look after, and therefore, in this circumstances, it is very hard for her to travel alongwith her child to Meerut to contest the case instituted by the opposite party. Necessary averments in this respect have been made in paragraph 12 of the affidavit filed in support of the transfer application which is being reproduced hereinbelow:-

"12. That the Applicant has a minor child and a serviceman lady, who is working in Bank at Agra, due to this reason she is not able to attend the Court at Meerut. The Applicant is living alone at Agra and no one look after her child."
The averments made by the applicant in paragraph 12 are unrebutted, and therefore, they are being treated to be correct.

As the applicant has a minor child whom she is taking care of, therefore, it is very difficult for her to travel alongwith her child to Meerut to contest the case instituted by the opposite party, therefore, this Court is of the opinion that balance of convenience lays in favour of applicant, and accordingly, in the interest of justice, the Case No.555 of 2020 (Jugunu George Das Vs. Smt. Prerna Paul), under Section 10 (ix) & (x) of the Divorce Act 1869 is transferred from the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, District Meerut to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Agra.

The Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut is directed to remit the record of Case No.555 of 2020 (Jugunu George Das Vs. Smt. Prerna Paul), under Section 10 (ix) & (x) of the Divorce Act 1869 to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Agra for disposal of suit.
The Transfer Application is allowed with no order as to costs.
